0.0.1.en: Added support for DCH-Z110 and DCH-Z120 / motion and door/window sensors

0.0.3.en: Added support for DCH-Z122 / motion sensor

0.1.1.en: Added support for DCH-Z310 / Smoke Sensor

0.2.1.en: Improved DCH-Z510 siren controls and Z-Wave notification handling.

0.2.2.en: Minor metadata cleanup for DCH-Z510 Flow cards.

0.3.0.en: Added local Wi-Fi/LAN support for DSP-W215 smart plugs (on/off, power and temperature) and DCH-S220 sirens (sound selection, volume, duration and Flow controls). Includes refinements to the existing DCH-Z510 siren support. Hardware compatibility may vary by model revision and firmware.

0.3.1.en: Improved DCH-S220 local pairing for firmware that requires PIN authentication before device identification.
